label: Attractor nodes
concept: Particles are pulled toward moving attractors and their short trails accumulate into the basins between them.
params: `attractors` is how many bodies the particles feel; `pull` is the force constant (raise it and the particles collapse onto the nearest body); `drag` is how quickly velocity decays, which is what makes the paths curl rather than run straight; `wobble` is the noise added to the pull, and it is what makes the basins legible; `veil` is how much history one frame keeps.
